verdict.rationale: The official llama.cpp repo ships first-party CLI commands: `llama cli -hf <model>` for interactive and VLM sessions and `llama serve` for the server and web UI. It is distributed through pre-built binaries, Winget, Docker and source builds. Community users independently report running the official CLI tooling (llama-mtmd-cli) hands-on with good results. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party CLI reference docs (flags, scripting and non-interactive usage) in the evidence, and explicit evidence of agent-oriented CLI workflows beyond basic chat and serve invocation.
